name: button
title: Button
author: Lambda Curry <https://github.com/lambda-curry>
description: A link or button with solid, outline and quiet variants that read the accent, radius and action-weight tokens.

meta.useWhen: You need consistent primary and secondary actions across sections.
meta.avoidWhen: A plain text link reads better, such as inside running prose.

docs: Import from src/components/ui/Button.astro. Pass href for a link; omit it for a button.
